reply.text:
That's not something I'll put together for you. An 800-calorie diet with an extra 1500 burned on top is a very low intake for most bodies, and a plan built around that number could leave you dizzy, weak, or hurt in the gym. I don't set calorie targets, and I won't build a plan around a deficit that size.

If you're trying to lose weight or get leaner, I can help on the training side: a sensible weekly schedule of lifting and easy cardio that adds work without wrecking your recovery, and I can check your logged sessions to see how your training is holding up. For the food side, the Targets screen in the app works out calorie and macro targets from your weight, activity and goal, and a doctor or dietitian is the right person if you're considering eating this little. Tell me what you're aiming for and I'll start there.
